entities.summary: Adam Almqvist is a professional Swedish ice hockey player who plays for Kölner Haie of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Almqvist was drafted 210th overall by the Detroit Red Wings in the 2009 NHL Entry Draft.
